anchors.paper_title: Whole-brain electrophysiological functional connectivity dynamics in resting-state EEG
anchors.reason: Shou, Yuan et al. propose an analytic framework for dynamic FC in resting-state EEG; it is topically related but does not clearly describe this specific dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded with a 128-channel Amps 300 amplifier (Electrical Geodesics Inc.) at 1000 Hz sampling rate during resting state. Structural MRI was acquired using a GE MR750 scanner with GE's BRAVO sequence (FOV=240mm, 180 axial slices per slab). Preprocessing in EEGLAB included band-pass filtering (0.5-100 Hz), notch filtering (58-62 Hz), removal of noisy channels and artifacts (eye blinks, muscle movements, heartbeats), interpolation of bad channels, re-referencing to the average of all electrodes, and downsampling to 250 Hz. No data segments were removed to preserve continuity.
